audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer stages for Level 3, First item and 2+ items are marked Darius but carried generic Akshan-favoured why text ("trades start at angles melee kits literally cannot answer", "take over the lane"), so the chart and the prose disagreed on the same page.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are genuinely Akshan's because Darius has no gap-closer until Apprehend at 3. From 3 onward the pull decides the lane, which is exactly what the content layer already says.
audit.corrected: Those three stage whys now state the Darius-side reason: Apprehend at 3, Hemorrhage stacks surviving your Youmuu's spike, and a fed Darius one-shotting you on any catch.

audit.why: Spike stages are right: Akshan at 1-2 pre-Apprehend, Darius at 3 (Apprehend), Darius at 6 (Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80), Akshan at Youmuu's. All four are in the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Noxian Guillotine is described in three separate strings as true damage that scales with your MISSING HP. Riot's description says the damage "is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target" — it scales with bleed stacks, not missing health. Apprehend's passive armour penetration was never mentioned anywhere, and dosFull[2] called a whiffed Apprehend a "fifteen-second invitation".
audit.why: The missing-HP framing tells you to watch your health bar; the real tell is the Hemorrhage stack count, which can be at five while you are still healthy. Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — the longest punish window in the slice, and the page reported it as fifteen. Its passive armour shred also means buying armour does not fix the trade.
audit.corrected: Guillotine now scales off Hemorrhage stacks in all three places, Apprehend is stated at its real 26s rank-1 cooldown with its passive armour shred, and the whiff invitation is corrected to twenty-six seconds.

edits.before: Once Darius has E at 3 the lane equalizes — Apprehend out-ranges your comfort zone, so always fight near a wall so Heroic Swing (E) can swing you clear of the pull. At 4-5 you still win the spacing war by Q-poking and backing off before he closes, but if he ever lands Apprehend you're getting bled and possibly executed. At 6 his Noxian Guillotine deals true damage that ramps with your missing HP and resets on kill, so the second your bar dips low with Hemorrhage ticking he ults you out — keep that buffer and use your third-stack shield to eat the chip.
edits.after: Once Darius has E at 3 the lane equalizes — Apprehend out-ranges your comfort zone, so always fight near a wall where Heroic Swing (E) can pull you clear. It is 26s at rank 1, so a whiffed pull hands you a full 26 seconds of free poke. At 4-5 you still win the spacing war by Q-poking and backing off before he closes, but if he lands Apprehend you're getting bled, and its passive armour shred means buying armour does not fix that trade. At 6 Noxian Guillotine's true damage grows with every Hemorrhage stack on you and refreshes on a kill, so watch the bleed counter, not just your health bar.

notes: content late still calls the five-stack Hemorrhage buff 'Noxian Might'. Riot's description only says Darius 'enrages and gains massive Attack Damage' without naming it, so the name was left alone and logged as unverified rather than asserted or deleted. The packet flagged whys[4]'s 'His Guillotine' as a suspect name — it is correct shorthand for Noxian Guillotine and was not the real problem; the missing-HP scaling in the same sentence was.
